question: Which signalized junction has the slowest queue dissipation? For each TLS, count queued vehicles (speed < 0.1 m/s) on its incoming edges at each simulation second. Find the earliest timestep with the peak queue count. Then scan forward to find the first subsequent second where the queue count drops strictly below 50%% of the peak. The dissipation time is that second minus the peak second. If the queue never drops below 50%% of the peak, use the last simulation second minus the peak second. Only consider TLS with peak queue >= 4 vehicles. Report the TLS with the longest dissipation time. Break ties by higher peak count, then lexicographic TLS id. Answer format: <tls_id>
